summary: Applied AI and cloud platform engineer with about eight years of experience turning enterprise requirements into production systems across application, platform, security, and operations. At Samsung Electronics, I design and deliver an internal AX Agent Platform on AWS EKS and have supported a global B2C generative AI service on Azure through UK rollout and early production stabilization.

Hands-on with Python, Kubernetes, cloud-native architecture, API and runtime integration, CI/CD, observability, authentication and authorization, and incident response. I carry delivery from architecture and implementation through enterprise integration, rollout, and production operation.

projects.title: Enterprise AI Assistant with Evaluation & Access Control
projects.description: Public reference implementation with access-aware retrieval, grounded citations, audit events, and repeatable evaluations.
projects.detailedDescription: Built a synthetic, inspectable enterprise assistant to demonstrate application code and production-quality controls without using internal company data or architecture. The implementation includes SQLite FTS5 retrieval, role filtering before model context is assembled, grounded citations, audit events, runtime metadata, evaluation cases, a FastAPI surface, an offline deterministic provider, and an optional OpenAI Responses API provider.
projects.problem: Show how an enterprise AI assistant can enforce authorization and evaluate behavior instead of stopping at a chat prototype.
projects.role: Designed and implemented the reference application, access policy, retrieval path, provider interface, audit model, evaluation suite, tests, and browser experience.
projects.engineering: Python, FastAPI, SQLite FTS5/BM25, pre-generation role filtering, grounded citations, audit events, evaluation cases, and optional OpenAI Responses API integration.
projects.outcome: Published an interactive browser demo and inspectable backend reference with automated access-safety and retrieval tests.
projects.relevance: Provides direct evidence of hands-on Applied AI engineering across application logic, evaluation, failure handling, access control, observability, and model-provider integration.

projects.title: Internal AX Agent Platform
projects.description: AWS EKS-based platform for deploying and operating AX applications with automated domains, access control, governance, and LLM Gateway integration.
projects.detailedDescription: Designed and built an internal AX Agent Platform on AWS EKS from July 2026, carrying the work from architecture and runtime adaptation through deployment and production operation. Translated enterprise deployment, access, security, and governance requirements into a self-service workflow where developers release AX applications, receive domains automatically, and restrict access to authorized users. The platform also enables applications to consume the existing enterprise LLM Gateway API through client-side compatibility and integration.
projects.problem: Enable teams to deploy AX applications quickly while enforcing enterprise access control, security, and AI governance.
projects.role: Owned end-to-end platform delivery from architecture and implementation through deployment and operation, including authentication, authorization, security, and internal governance.
projects.engineering: AWS EKS, AX Agent runtime adaptation, automated domain provisioning, access control, policy enforcement, and client integration with the existing LLM Gateway.
projects.outcome: Created a self-service path for governed AX application deployment with automatic domains and authorized-only access.
projects.relevance: Demonstrates end-to-end enterprise application platform delivery across requirements, architecture, runtime compatibility, deployment automation, security, governance, and LLM integration.

projects.description: Microsoft Azure-based B2C generative AI service expanded to the UK with initial production operations and incident response.
projects.detailedDescription: Collaborated with Microsoft on the UK expansion of a global B2C generative AI service on Azure. The work covered rollout readiness, initial production operations, incident response, and early service stabilization from January to June 2026.
projects.problem: Expand a consumer-facing generative AI service to the UK and stabilize its initial production operations.
projects.role: Delivered platform/SRE responsibilities for UK rollout readiness, initial production operations, incident response, and early stabilization.
projects.engineering: Azure and Kubernetes operations, rollout readiness, production stabilization, and incident response.
projects.outcome: Delivered UK rollout readiness and early production stabilization, completing the engagement in June 2026.
projects.relevance: Shows hands-on delivery experience for an international consumer application rollout and its transition into stable production operation.

Responsibilities covered end-to-end infrastructure, platform, and application operations while meeting internal security, authentication, and data protection standards.

projects.title: Kubernetes Cluster Automation
projects.description: One-click Kubernetes cluster provisioning for repeatable developer and test environments.
projects.detailedDescription: Developed an automated one-click provisioning system for Kubernetes clusters, providing cloud developers with streamlined, ready-to-use development environments. The work reduced manual setup and made cluster creation more repeatable for development and experimentation.

projects.role: Designed and implemented provisioning automation for Kubernetes clusters and shared platform modules.
projects.engineering: Bash-based provisioning and automation, reusable cluster modules, and developer environment standardization.

projects.title: LLM Performance Evaluation Pipeline
projects.description: Automated evaluation pipeline for repeatable LLM quality and performance comparison across Machine Translation tasks.
projects.detailedDescription: Built an automated pipeline for evaluating the performance and quality of LLM models across Machine Translation tasks. The pipeline tracked benchmark results and quality metrics with MLflow to support repeatable model comparison.
projects.problem: LLM model quality needed repeatable evaluation rather than ad hoc manual checks.
projects.role: Built the evaluation workflow and metric tracking path for Machine Translation model comparison.
projects.engineering: Python evaluation automation, PyTorch-based workloads, MLflow metric tracking, and Kubernetes execution.
projects.outcome: Made LLM evaluation results easier to compare and reproduce across model candidates.
projects.relevance: Maps directly to AI workload evaluation, model performance analysis, and repeatable application quality workflows.

projects.role: Built the monitoring path and dashboards used for platform and service operations.
projects.engineering: Prometheus metrics, Grafana dashboards, OpenTelemetry signals, Loki logging, and alert rules.

projects.title: High-throughput Packet Mirroring Application
projects.description: Real-time packet mirroring application that forwarded up to 130,000 packets/sec under constrained resources.
projects.detailedDescription: Developed an application that mirrors up to 130,000 packets per second in real time and forwards them to a target server within constrained system resources. This work emphasizes system-level performance, resource awareness, and reliable data movement.
projects.problem: Network/application teams needed real-time packet forwarding under limited system resources.
projects.role: Implemented the packet mirroring application and tuned it for resource-constrained operation.
projects.engineering: High-throughput I/O, Linux runtime behavior, resource limits, and real-time data forwarding.
projects.outcome: Delivered a system component capable of forwarding up to 130,000 packets/sec.
projects.relevance: Strengthens System Software fit through Linux runtime behavior, high-throughput data movement, and resource-aware performance work.

projects.title: Distributed CNN Training System
projects.description: Research on accelerated CNN distributed deep learning with automatic resource-aware layer placement.
projects.detailedDescription: Research on accelerated training for CNN distributed deep learning through automatic resource-aware layer placement. Published in USENIX NSDI 2019 and arXiv. Achieved up to 2.3x speedup in training time.
projects.problem: Distributed CNN training suffered from network bottlenecks and inefficient layer placement.
projects.role: Contributed to research on resource-aware placement for distributed TensorFlow/CNN training.
projects.engineering: Distributed systems, model parallelism, resource-aware scheduling, TensorFlow, and GPU-aware workloads.
projects.outcome: Published research artifacts including USENIX NSDI 2019 poster and arXiv paper; reported up to 2.3x training speedup.
projects.relevance: Shows AI systems depth beyond application code, especially distributed training, workload analysis, and resource optimization.

projects.detailedDescription: Built a Siri-like AI assistant on TmaxOS, focusing on system-level integration, AI model inference, and data preprocessing. Designed an asynchronous architecture to enable smooth and natural user experiences.
projects.problem: The OS environment needed an AI assistant that could connect user interaction with system-level capabilities.
projects.role: Built AI inference and preprocessing flows and integrated them with TmaxOS-level behavior.
projects.engineering: Async architecture, system integration, AI model inference, and data preprocessing.
projects.outcome: Delivered an AI assistant experience with smoother interaction through asynchronous design.
projects.relevance: Connects AI application development with platform software, async runtime behavior, and system integration.
